Customize my controls
Step 1: To customize your controls, go to 'Settings'. Tap on the name of your device.
Step 2: Tap 'Earbud controls' and select 'Left' or 'Right' to begin customizing.
Head Gestures
Step 1: Go to 'Settings'. Tap on the name of your device. Tap 'Head gestures' and turn the toggle on.

This is the official video guide on how to set up and personalize audio settings for a full Hi-Fi sound experience with Galaxy Buds4 Pro. Discover how to elevate your listening experience by enabling 'Ultra high quality (UHQ) audio', using adaptive Equalizer, and experiencing clearer calls with Super Clear Call. This guide also shows you how to further customize your sound with the 9-band Equalizer, immerse yourself in spatial audio with '360 audio', and optimize your listening environment with enhanced adaptive Active Noise Canceling. From achieving a proper earbud fit, to exploring advanced sound settings in One UI, you’ll be guided through simple steps designed to unlock clearer detail, improved sound clarity, and a more fine-tuned listening experience whether you’re enjoying music, watching videos, or taking calls. Learn more: http://smsng.co/Buds4Pro_Hi-Fi_How-to_yt

This is the official video guide on how to use Privacy Display on Galaxy S26 Ultra. Want to keep your private information protected from prying eyes effortlessly? Meet Galaxy S26 Ultra, the world's first smartphone with Privacy Display. Privacy Display is a built-in privacy screen, ideal for users who want to protect their private information by hiding their full screen or certain apps or notifications from other people’s view with innovative technology 🚀 Customize what Privacy Display hides by selecting the apps and notifications you want to keep for your eyes only 👀 With Privacy Display, you can check important notifications and apps in a packed bus or train, or enjoy streaming your favorite shows on your phone with friends, worry-free! Learn more: http://smsng.co/S26Ultra_Privacy_How-to_yt
